name: Side-to-Side Weight Shift

instructions.description: Stand with feet wider than hip width and knees softly bent.
Shift your body weight onto one leg while keeping the opposite foot in light contact with the floor.
Move smoothly across to the other side without rushing or collapsing at the trunk.
Continue for the planned number of slow shifts.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count each transfer from one side to the other.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Progress by fully unloading the opposite foot.

commentsNotes: Keep the movement smooth and centered.
